_comment: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA. Citebook's additions to universe/facts.json (copied unchanged from Citedesk). Every customer, address, phone number, booking and ZIP code here is invented. Where this file and facts.json disagree, facts.json wins; tests/test_universe_extension.py checks they agree.

visit_windows._comment: 2-hour arrival windows inside facts.json hours.scheduled_visits: first window starts at first_arrival, last window ends at last_arrival, no overlaps.

citebook_policies._comment: Policies only Citebook has (online booking). They are published to the knowledge base by tools/build_data.py.

zip_areas._comment: Invented ZIP codes in the unassigned 000xx range, mapped to the neighbourhoods in facts.json service_area.
